stem.text: Which graph correctly shows possible changes in energy levels as a chemical reaction progresses with or without an enzyme?

stem.alt: Key: a solid line labelled with enzyme, a dashed line labelled without enzyme, S labelled substrate and P labelled product.

A.alt: Graph of energy levels against progress of reaction, with labels S and P, one solid curve and one dashed curve.
